page.overview:
What is Too Late Too Late?

Too Late Too Late is the sixteenth track from Metallica's cover album Garage, Inc.. Disc 2.

Originally released by Motörhead in 1979 on the album Overkill, Metallica has already released their version in their 1996's Hero of the Day single.

I see that nothing's changed Insist on playin' games Some waste of time you are And you're so popular Well this is it you bitch I got to make my switch You find some other john I know what's goin' on

Your move What do I have to lose Stalemate Too late, too late
